sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package settings for the lint tool
sections.what: Describes the lint package: its name, version, Python version needed, the bhoomi-lint command, and the build setup.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed so the lint tool can be installed like any Python package. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The package has no declared dependencies, so anything it needs at run time must be added here.

summary: Configuration file that names the lint package, its entry command, and how it is built.
purpose: Lets the lint tool be installed and run as a command called bhoomi-lint.
why: Likely reason: a standard way to package Python code for installation. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Declares the package name and version, requires Python 3.12 or newer, sets no dependencies, maps the bhoomi-lint command to the main function, and tells the build tool where the package code sits.
inputs: Read by the build tool and the Python installer, not by the app.
outputs: An installable package with a bhoomi-lint command.
risks: Dependencies are empty, but the tests import hypothesis and pytest, which are not listed here. A fresh install may fail the test run.
debug: If the command is missing after install, check the project scripts section. If the tests fail with missing modules, check that the test dependencies are installed separately.
